Saved SIR simulations and synthetic field observations for calibration

Source: R/data-dt_calibration.R
dt_calibration.Rd

A 6 by 6 grid with 26 observation times, including physical time zero. Training uses 40 simulator inputs; ten further inputs are held out. Responses and observations are on the log(I + 1) scale. This is a different simulation design from dt_emulation: eta1 bounds are 2 to 4 here, whereas dt_emulation uses inputs near 1 to 2.

Usage

dt_calibration

Format

A list with training and validation lists (input matrices and time-indexed response matrices); named lower and upper parameter bounds; Nx, Ny, time, and grid metadata; a field list containing observations, original-grid indices, discrepancy correlation, and prior settings; a separate truth list used only for validation/plots; and provenance containing input identifiers, response scale, seed, and source checksums.

Source

Saved SIR simulations following Equation (26) in Banerjee, Chen, Frankenburg and Zhou (2025), JMLR 26(146). The field-generation/import script is maintained in data-raw.

See also

calibration_prepare(), calibration_fit()

Examples

data("dt_calibration")
d <- dt_calibration
rbind(lower = d$lower, upper = d$upper, truth = d$truth$eta)
#>       eta1 eta2 alpha1 alpha2 alpha3
#> lower    2  0.2      0    0.0      0
#> upper    4  0.4      0    0.2      0
#> truth    3  0.3      0    0.1      0
dim(d$field$z)
#> [1] 26 36
length(d$training$responses)
#> [1] 26
